gloss: above all; more than anything; best of all

definitions.explanation: Marks one thing as the most important or the best of all: {何|なに}よりも{大切|たいせつ} (more important than anything).
After a clause or noun with で, says that something is the best possible outcome, as in ご{無事|ぶじ}で{何|なに}よりです (I am so glad you are safe).

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何|なに}より⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Health is more important than anything.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}より⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Above all, he values his family.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何|なに}より⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Above all, this job demands punctuality.

examples.japanese: ご⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧で{何|なに}よりです。
examples.english: I am so glad you are safe.

examples.japanese: お⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧そうで{何|なに}よりです。
examples.english: It is wonderful to see you looking well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{怪我|けが}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何|なに}よりだった。
examples.english: Nobody was badly hurt, and that was the main thing.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {何|なに}より(⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧)〜: more ~ than anything
- 〜で{何|なに}よりです: I am glad that ~ (a set phrase of relief and good wishes)
- {何|なに}より⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: the best ~ ({何|なに}より⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧, the best present)

USAGE:
Sense 2 is a fixed, slightly formal courtesy phrase: ご⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧で{何|なに}より, お⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧で{何|なに}より. It expresses relief at someone else's good fortune, so it is not used about oneself.
